title: An offer that may be rejected
hook: Two stated cases: explore the offer and the stated acceptance probability.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the offer and the stated acceptance probability affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Expected, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the offer and the stated acceptance probability in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy proposer divides pie 10, offers 5, and is accepted with probability 1; rejection pays zero. What is the proposer’s expected payoff?
